title: Assam: Digboi Refinery sees fresh labour protest over Unified Attendance System

ai.summary: Employees at Indian Oil Corporation's Digboi Refinery staged a protest demanding withdrawal of the Unified Attendance System (UAS), which they argue centralizes administrative control and hinders local problem resolution.

facts.claim: Employees and office-bearers of the INTUC-affiliated Assam Oil Company Labour Union (AOCLU) staged a fresh demonstration at Indian Oil Corporation Limited’s Digboi Refinery
facts.quote: Employees and office-bearers of the INTUC-affiliated Assam Oil Company Labour Union (AOCLU) staged a fresh demonstration at Indian Oil Corporation Limited’s Digboi Refinery

facts.claim: The latest protest comes amid recurring labour disputes at the Digboi refinery
facts.quote: The latest protest comes amid recurring labour disputes at the Digboi refinery

facts.claim: Employees have also expressed reservations about the proposed change in administrative control
facts.quote: Employees have also expressed reservations about the proposed change in administrative control

facts.claim: The employee said this centralisation could make it more difficult for local workers to resolve attendance-related problems
facts.quote: The employee said this centralisation could make it more difficult for local workers to resolve attendance-related problems

facts.claim: The refinery management, however, has defended the new system, describing it as an upgraded and user-friendly mechanism to modernise attendance registration
facts.quote: The refinery management, however, has defended the new system, describing it as an upgraded and user-friendly mechanism to modernise attendance registration

ai.background_note: The Digboi Refinery is a key industrial site in Assam, and the UAS implementation has sparked ongoing labor tensions, with the union and management at odds over administrative control and worker grievances.
